title: World (data/world.json)
description: How rooms connect, where they sit on the world map, and the key fragments (D101). The core is an object in a room (defs.json kind "core"); where fragments lie is the rooms' pickups.

connections.description: Pairs of connected exits as "room.exit". Exits must be on opposite sides and equally wide.

fragments.description: Key fragments (D101): how many end the game at the core, and the access levels they earn there.

required.description: Fragments the core needs to reboot the Grid (the end of the game).

access.description: Fragments found for each access level, in rising order: [16, 32, 48] gives level 1 at 16, 2 at 32, 3 at 48. The core raises the level when he touches it.

positions.description: Every room's cell on the world map (D66) as [x, z], by room id: +x is east, +z is south, as in a room. One room per cell; neighbours on the map need not be connected.
